g1.label: 1. Red foxes have ___ red or orange fur
g1.why: Foxes are known for their bright red-orange coat.

g2.label: 2. Foxes are ___
g2.why: “Nocturnal” means active at night, which is what the rest of the sentence says.

g3.label: 3. A group of foxes is a ___
g3.why: A group of foxes is a skulk; a pack is wolves and a herd is cattle or deer.

g4.label: 4. Baby foxes are called ___
g4.why: Baby foxes are cubs; kittens are cats and pups are dogs or seals.

g5.label: 5. A hedgehog is covered in ___
g5.why: A hedgehog’s coat is made of spines — scales belong to fish, feathers to birds.

g6.label: 6. When afraid, a hedgehog ___
g6.why: It rolls up into a ball so the spines point outwards and protect it.

g7.label: 7. Hedgehogs ___ in winter
g7.why: Hedgehogs hibernate — they sleep through the winter rather than migrating.

g8.label: 8. Hedgehog habitats are getting ___
g8.why: Habitats shrink as towns and cities grow and take over the space.
